response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(unit_price) AS overall_avg FROM Products), type_averages AS (SELECT production_type_code, AVG(unit_price) AS type_avg FROM Products GROUP BY production_type_code), kept AS (SELECT t.production_type_code, t.type_avg FROM type_averages t CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE t.type_avg > o.overall_avg), kept_mean AS (SELECT AVG(type_avg) AS mean_type_avg FROM kept) SELECT AVG(k.type_avg) AS average_type_price, AVG(k.type_avg - o.overall_avg) AS average_above_overall, AVG(k.type_avg - m.mean_type_avg) AS average_above_kept_mean FROM kept k CROSS JOIN overall o CROSS JOIN kept_mean m WHERE k.type_avg > m.mean_type_avg
